notes: «- وهو ابن زريع -», «- وهو ابن المفضل -» and «- واللفظ لبشر -» are editor glosses and are left out.
«قال وأنبأنا» opens a second isnad for the same saying; both meet at شعبة, and the names after it are written once as the shared tail.
«أبيه» is Usama's, named only by relation; the saying is his (rule 6).
